SearchProblem.description: Problem details of a failed search request. In addition to the usual problem properties, it explains which search step failed. See [understanding search errors](/guide/search/understanding-search-errors).

debug.description: Debug data of all search steps before the failed step, in the same format as the `debug` property of successful requests. Returned for failed steps independent of the `debug` request property, as long as failure explanations are enabled.

failedStep.description: Explains the search step which failed.

index.description: Zero-based index of the failed step inside `steps`.

debug.description: Debug data of the failed step up to the point of failure.

source.description: Technology which was diagnosed, e.g. `neo4j` or `elasticsearch`. Only set if the failure could be diagnosed.

diagnostics.description: Allowlisted data which got passed through from the database, e.g. its error code, its message and the position inside of the query.

expressionError.description: Explains a failed expression. Only set if the failure was caused by an expression.

diagnostics.description: Kind of error (`compile error` or `runtime error`), its message and, if available, `line` and `column`.
